newsitem.title: ITALY: MOTOR RACING-NANNINI TAKES STAKE IN MINARDI.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-NANNINI TAKES STAKE IN MINARDI.

text.p: Former Formula One driver Alessandro Nannini and Benetton boss Flavio Briatore have taken a stake in Minardi, the Italian team said on Wednesday.
Minardi said in a statement that it had a new company structure, with Briatore and Nannini joining other international entrepreneurs in taking a 70 percent stake.
Italian Nannini, who had his arm sewn back after it was severed in a helicopter crash six years ago, tested a Benetton last Monday at Portugal's Estoril circuit.
Despite a strong performance, Nannini has insisted that he will never be able to return to Formula One.
Minardi said it had begun a "long-term plan" to improve its form. That included a deal for the exclusive use of Hart V8 engines and a two-year deal with Bridgestone tyres.
The statement said the new Minardi M197 would be ready before the middle of next January. The team hoped to announce its official drivers for 1997 in the next few weeks.
